data.statement: Append-only timing correction: evt-20260906-v10-gratiator-24h-learning called the measurement an exact 24-hour checkpoint. The scheduled 24-hour checkpoint was actually captured 24 hours and 36 seconds after publication, as already recorded correctly in evt-20260906-v10-gratiator-24h-metrics. The zero values and decision to keep measuring are unchanged.
data.decision: Describe this observation as the scheduled 24-hour checkpoint captured 24 hours and 36 seconds after publication; preserve the original event and this correction under the append-only policy.
data.nextAction: Use exact elapsed timing in future checkpoint learning language and retain the seven-day and 28-day measurement gates.
